title: 通信行业日报 · 2026-10-21（周三）
theme: 前三季度成绩单——智能算力同比增146%，运营商主业承压，AI进入无线网现网调优
theme_en: Q1–Q3 scorecard: China's intelligent computing power up 146%, operators' core revenue under pressure, and AI moves into live radio-network tuning

highlights.label: 算力
highlights.text: 国新办发布会：智能算力达2592 EFLOPS、同比增146%；5G基站525.4万个，两家民企获批卫星物联网商用试验。

highlights.label: 运营商
highlights.text: 中国移动Q3归母净利润同比降12.2%、经营现金流增15.1%；中国铁塔前三季度净利增24.2%；中国电信600万台微型机顶盒集采定标。

highlights.label: AI-RAN
highlights.text: Singtel与爱立信签五年5G-A合作；T-Mobile与爱立信公布AI波束赋形现网增益：高峰下行用户吞吐量提升16%。

highlights.label: 科研
highlights.text: 三篇新稿：无人机任务意图多模态识别基准、多无人机协同细粒度检测、可移动天线多站协同安全通感。

research.title: AeroIntent：面向无人机任务意图识别的同步多模态基准
research.title_en: AeroIntent: A Synchronized Multimodal Benchmark for UAV Mission Intent Recognition
research.authors: Yutong Chen, Jingxin Mao, Zhiwei Wei, Bing Li, Jianzhong Ni, Rongqing Zhang
research.summary: 990段雷达/RGB/红外/深度同步序列覆盖5类任务意图；AeroMIR在程序不相交协议下Macro-F1达69.84%，较最强纯轨迹基线高7.79个点。
research.summary_en: 990 synchronized radar/RGB/infrared/depth sequences span five mission intents; under a program-disjoint protocol AeroMIR reaches 69.84% Macro-F1, 7.79 points above the strongest trajectory-only baseline.
research.detail: 低空空域监管不仅要“看到”无人机，还要判断它“想干什么”。现有多模态无人机数据集主要服务检测、跟踪与定位，缺少对任务级意图识别的评测，尤其是对未见过的飞行程序和雷达历史不完整的情形。Rongqing Zhang团队提出的AeroIntent是一个仿真基准，包含由22种轨迹程序生成的990段同步多模态序列，覆盖5类任务意图，同时提供雷达、RGB、红外与深度观测，并设计了程序不相交、雷达缺测与观测前缀（早期识别）三类评测协议。在此基础上，作者提出结构化多模态意图推理器AeroMIR，把雷达轨迹、派生行为特征、精选视觉证据与任务知识融合起来做候选式意图推理。在评估未见战术实现的严格程序不相交协议下，AeroMIR三次随机种子平均准确率71.56%、Macro-F1 69.84%，较最强纯轨迹基线高7.79个点，较传统雷达—RGB后融合基线高19.32个点，并在雷达缺测和早期识别设定下保持较强表现。对通感基站、低空雷达与光电联合监视之上的“意图研判”层有直接参考价值。
research.detail_en: Low-altitude airspace oversight needs not only to see a drone but to judge what it intends to do. Existing multimodal UAV datasets mainly support detection, tracking and localization, and offer little for evaluating mission-level intent—especially for unseen flight programs and incomplete radar histories. AeroIntent, from Rongqing Zhang's group, is a simulation benchmark of 990 synchronized multimodal sequences generated by 22 trajectory programs across five mission intents, providing radar, RGB, infrared and depth observations along with program-disjoint, radar-gap and observation-prefix (early recognition) evaluation protocols. On top of it, the authors propose AeroMIR, a structured multimodal intent reasoner that fuses radar trajectories, derived behavioral features, selected visual evidence and task knowledge for candidate-based intent recognition. Under the strict program-disjoint protocol, which tests unseen tactical realizations, AeroMIR averages 71.56% accuracy and 69.84% Macro-F1 over three seeds—7.79 points above the strongest trajectory-only baseline and 19.32 points above a conventional radar–RGB late-fusion baseline—and stays strong under radar gaps and early-recognition settings. It is directly relevant to the intent-assessment layer sitting above ISAC base stations, low-altitude radar and electro-optical surveillance.

research.title: CARNet：端到端耦合关联与识别的多无人机协同细粒度检测
research.title_en: CARNet: End-to-End Coupled Association-Recognition Network for Fine-Grained Multi-Drone Collaborative Detection
research.authors: Zhao Zhang, Ruigang Fu, Yu Zhang, Jiajun Xiang, Zixuan Xiao, Ping Zhong
research.summary: 以共享目标对表征联合优化跨视角关联与融合识别，引入两种因果启发干预策略，并发布首个多无人机协同车辆细粒度检测基准MDMT-CD。
research.summary_en: Jointly optimizes cross-view association and fusion-based recognition through a shared target-pair representation, adds two causal-inspired interventions, and releases MDMT-CD, the first fine-grained benchmark for multi-drone collaborative vehicle detection.
research.detail: 多无人机协同检测利用多架无人机重叠视角的互补观测提升目标识别能力。现有方法多采用“先建立跨视角对应、再做融合识别”的两阶段流程，存在优化目标不一致、成对建模冗余和错误不可逆传播等问题——一旦关联出错，后续识别必然受损。作者提出耦合关联—识别网络CARNet，通过共享的目标对表征，把跨视角目标关联与融合识别放进同一框架联合优化；为在目标密集、外观相似的场景中提高关联可靠性，模型在成对关系建模中显式引入空间线索。论文还设计了两种互补的因果启发干预策略：一种强调外观易混淆的目标对以增强跨视角关联，另一种在视觉证据不完整时学习稳定的多视角表征，提升融合识别的鲁棒性。作者同时发布MDMT-CD数据集，在MDMT原有车辆标注上补充细粒度类别，是首个专门面向多无人机协同车辆检测的基准。实验显示CARNet持续优于现有方法。对低空多机协同感知中“哪些信息需要在机间共享、何时共享”的设计具有参考意义。
research.detail_en: Multi-drone collaborative detection uses complementary observations from overlapping aerial viewpoints to improve target recognition. Most existing methods follow a two-stage pipeline—first establish cross-view correspondences, then fuse for recognition—which suffers from inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant pairwise modeling and irreversible error propagation: once an association is wrong, recognition inevitably suffers. The authors propose CARNet, a Coupled Association-Recognition Network that jointly optimizes cross-view target association and recognition fusion through a shared target-pair representation, and explicitly injects spatial cues into pairwise relation modeling to keep associations reliable in dense scenes with look-alike targets. Two complementary causal-inspired interventions are introduced: one emphasizes appearance-confusing pairs to strengthen association, the other learns stable multi-view representations under incomplete visual evidence to make fusion-based recognition more robust. The paper also releases MDMT-CD, which enriches the MDMT dataset's vehicle annotations with fine-grained categories—the first benchmark built specifically for multi-drone collaborative vehicle detection. Experiments show CARNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, offering guidance on what information drones should share with each other, and when, in low-altitude cooperative sensing.

research.title: 可移动天线赋能的多站协同安全通感一体化：架构、机理与使能技术
research.title_en: Movable Antenna-Enabled Multi-Static Cooperative Secure ISAC: Architecture, Mechanisms, and Enabling Technologies
research.authors: Yan Yang, Zhendong Li, Jianwei Zhao, Qingqing Wu, Lipeng Zhu, Weimin Jia, Wen Chen
research.summary: 以“双尺度空间重构”统一局部天线几何与分布式网络几何，联合提升通信、感知与物理层安全，并展示节省天线的潜力。
research.summary_en: Uses dual-scale spatial reconfiguration to unify local antenna geometry and distributed network geometry, jointly improving communication, sensing and physical-layer security while showing antenna-saving potential.
research.detail: 通感一体化（ISAC）信号的广播特性使其易受窃听与干扰等物理层安全威胁。传统固定位置天线在合法、感知与敌方信道高度相关时空间自由度有限；多站协同ISAC虽能提供分布式空间分集，但仍存在信息泄露风险。Yan Yang、Qingqing Wu、Lipeng Zhu、Wen Chen等作者提出可移动天线（MA）赋能的多站协同安全ISAC框架，核心是“双尺度空间重构”：在局部，通过连续调整天线位置重塑传播信道；在网络层面，由分布式多站节点提供互补的空间分集。二者协同，把局部天线几何与分布式网络几何统一为一种可控的空间资源，同时增强通信、感知与安全性能。文章依次介绍系统架构与代表性应用场景、增益背后的物理层机理以及实际部署所需的关键使能技术，并通过案例研究展示通信—感知—安全三者的权衡和节省天线数量的潜力，最后梳理开放挑战与未来方向。对低空场景中多基站协同感知飞行器、同时防范窃听的网络设计具有借鉴意义。
research.detail_en: The broadcast nature of ISAC signals exposes them to physical-layer security threats such as eavesdropping and jamming. Fixed-position antennas offer limited spatial freedom when legitimate, sensing and adversarial channels are highly correlated, and while multi-static cooperative ISAC brings distributed spatial diversity, it still risks information leakage. Yan Yang, Qingqing Wu, Lipeng Zhu, Wen Chen and co-authors propose a movable-antenna (MA)-enabled multi-static cooperative secure ISAC framework built on dual-scale spatial reconfiguration: locally, continuous antenna repositioning reshapes propagation channels; at network level, distributed multi-static nodes provide complementary spatial diversity. Together they turn local antenna geometry and distributed network geometry into one controllable spatial resource that improves communication, sensing and security at once. The article sets out the architecture and representative scenarios, analyzes the physical-layer mechanisms behind the gains, and details the key enabling technologies for deployment; a case study shows the communication–sensing–security trade-off and the potential to save antennas, followed by open challenges and research directions. It offers ideas for low-altitude networks in which several base stations jointly sense aircraft while guarding against eavesdroppers.

items.title: Singtel与爱立信签署五年战略合作，规模化推进5G-A与AI原生网络
items.title_en: Singtel and Ericsson Sign Five-Year Strategic Partnership to Scale 5G-Advanced and AI-Native Networks
items.summary: 在3月合作基础上制定长期路线图；现网AI-RAN试验吞吐量提升19%，并将把网络切片与可编程连接扩展到自动驾驶、工业机器人等场景。
items.summary_en: Extends the March collaboration into a long-term roadmap; a live AI-RAN trial lifted throughput by 19%, and slicing and programmable connectivity will expand to autonomous vehicles, industrial robotics and more.
items.detail: 10月20日，新加坡电信（Singtel）与爱立信宣布签署为期五年的战略合作，在今年3月合作的基础上制定更长期的路线图，重点是在各行业规模化部署5G-Advanced与AI驱动的网络能力。双方此前已在现网开展AI无线接入网试验，吞吐量提升19%；近期还上线了在兼容新终端上最高250 Mbps的上行峰值速率能力。Singtel于2021年推出新加坡首张5G独立组网（SA）网络，2022年SA覆盖率超过95%，部署700MHz后覆盖（尤其室内）最多提升40%；2025年推出基于网络切片的5G+分级服务，PSA大士港则用5G切片支撑无人导引车、岸桥等系统的低时延通信。未来五年，双方将把网络切片与可编程连接扩展到自动驾驶、工业机器人、智能制造和智慧物流，并探索樟宜机场T5、Bulim Square及裕廊集团（JTC）新项目中的机会；网络侧将逐步把AI引入无线与核心网运维，用于预测流量、优化资源与能耗、提前发现性能问题。这是5G-A商业化从“能力上线”走向“行业规模复制”的又一样本。
items.detail_en: On Oct 20, Singtel and Ericsson announced a five-year strategic partnership that extends their March 2026 collaboration into a longer-term roadmap focused on scaling 5G-Advanced and AI-powered network capabilities across industries. A live-network AI-RAN trial has already delivered a 19% throughput gain, and the partners recently enabled peak uplink speeds of up to 250 Mbps on compatible newer devices. Singtel launched Singapore's first 5G standalone network in 2021 and passed 95% SA coverage in 2022; 700 MHz spectrum has improved coverage by up to 40%, especially indoors. In 2025 it introduced slicing-based 5G+ service tiers, and at PSA's Tuas Port 5G slicing supports low-latency links for automated guided vehicles, cranes and other systems. Over the next five years the partners will extend slicing and programmable connectivity to autonomous vehicles, industrial robotics, smart manufacturing and intelligent logistics, explore opportunities at Changi Airport Terminal 5, Bulim Square and upcoming JTC developments, and progressively bring AI into radio and core operations to predict traffic, optimize resources and energy, and catch performance issues earlier—another sign of 5G-A moving from feature launches to industry-scale replication.

items.title: T-Mobile美国公布AI管理波束赋形现网试验：高峰时段下行用户吞吐量提升16%
items.title_en: T-Mobile US Reveals Live AI-Managed Beamforming Trial: 16% Higher Peak-Hour Downlink User Throughput
items.summary: 基于自有数据训练的监督学习模型运行在爱立信RAN计算平台上，动态分配SRS资源；高级波束赋形使用增加约50%，频谱效率提升12%。
items.summary_en: A supervised-learning model trained on T-Mobile's own data runs on Ericsson RAN compute to allocate SRS resources dynamically; advanced beamforming use rises about 50% and spectral efficiency 12%.
items.detail: 10月20日，T-Mobile美国首席网络官Ankur Kapoor发文披露，公司正在5G-Advanced现网上大规模试验“AI管理波束赋形”，用商用流量验证AI分配无线资源的效果。试验聚焦探测参考信号（SRS）——终端发出的短时信号，网络借此测量终端与基站之间的信道、更精准地指向波束。SRS资源有限，传统上按固定规则分配；T-Mobile改用基于自有网络数据训练的监督学习模型，运行在爱立信RAN计算平台与芯片上，预测需求上升的位置并动态调配资源。纽约市新开通站点的结果显示，高峰时段收益最大：使用全带宽SRS的高级波束赋形增加约50%，下行用户吞吐量提升16%，频谱效率提升12%，下行数据量增加10%；不过博文未披露站点数量与对照基线。双方今年5月曾报告另一项AI原生调度与链路自适应现网试验，频谱效率提升近10%。Kapoor认为，波束赋形在上下行同频的TDD频段尤为有效，T-Mobile的中频TDD资源正适合这类优化，并把全国5G-A网络视为面向6G“感知、学习、响应”能力的试验场。
items.detail_en: On Oct 20, T-Mobile US chief network officer Ankur Kapoor wrote that the operator is trialling AI-Managed Beamforming at scale on live commercial traffic across its 5G-Advanced network. The work targets sounding reference signals (SRS)—short transmissions from phones that let the network measure the device-to-cell path and aim beams more precisely. SRS resources are limited and have traditionally been allocated by fixed rules; T-Mobile instead uses a supervised-learning model trained on its own network data, running on Ericsson RAN compute and silicon, to predict where demand is rising and redirect resources. Results from newly activated New York City sites show the biggest gains at peak hours: about 50% more advanced beamforming using full-band SRS, 16% higher downlink user throughput, 12% better spectral efficiency and 10% more downlink data volume, though the post gave no site count or baseline. In May the companies reported close to 10% better spectral efficiency from a separate AI-native scheduler with link adaptation. Kapoor said beamforming works especially well in TDD spectrum, where uplink and downlink share a band and T-Mobile leads in mid-band TDD, and called its nationwide 5G-A network the proving ground for 6G networks that sense, learn and respond.

items.title: 中国移动三季度归母净利润273亿元、同比降12.2%，经营现金流增15.1%
items.title_en: China Mobile's Q3 Net Profit Falls 12.2% to RMB 27.3 Billion as Operating Cash Flow Rises 15.1%
items.summary: Q3营收2423亿元、降3.4%，主营业务收入降5.1%；扣非净利润287亿元基本持平。移动客户10.14亿户，宽带客户前三季度净增1305万户。
items.summary_en: Q3 revenue fell 3.4% to RMB 242.3 billion, with telecom service revenue down 5.1%; recurring net profit of RMB 28.7 billion was roughly flat. Mobile customers reached 1.014 billion and broadband added 13.05 million in nine months.
items.detail: 10月20日晚，中国移动公布2026年第三季度主要经营数据。第三季度营业收入2423亿元，同比下降3.4%，其中主营业务收入2051亿元、下降5.1%，其他业务收入372亿元、增长7.2%；利润总额344亿元、下降13.4%，归母净利润273亿元、下降12.2%，扣除非经常性损益后的净利润287亿元，同比仅降0.2%。前三季度累计营业收入7803亿元、下降1.8%，归母净利润1062亿元、下降7.9%，EBITDA 2475亿元、下降6.7%，经营活动现金流1853亿元、增长15.1%。客户方面，移动客户达10.14亿户，前三季度净增889万户，其中5G网络客户7.02亿户；有线宽带客户3.42亿户，净增1305万户；物联网连接数14.97亿个。主营收入下滑、利润承压表明传统连接业务增长见顶；而扣非利润基本持平、现金流明显改善，说明成本管控与投资节奏调整仍在支撑经营质量。
items.detail_en: On the evening of Oct 20, China Mobile released its key Q3 2026 operating data. Q3 operating revenue was RMB 242.3 billion, down 3.4% year on year: telecom service revenue fell 5.1% to RMB 205.1 billion while other revenue rose 7.2% to RMB 37.2 billion. Total profit fell 13.4% to RMB 34.4 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders fell 12.2% to RMB 27.3 billion, while net profit excluding non-recurring items was RMB 28.7 billion, down only 0.2%. For the first nine months, revenue was RMB 780.3 billion (−1.8%), attributable net profit RMB 106.2 billion (−7.9%), EBITDA RMB 247.5 billion (−6.7%) and operating cash flow RMB 185.3 billion (+15.1%). Mobile customers reached 1.014 billion, a net gain of 8.89 million, including 702 million 5G network customers; wireline broadband customers reached 342 million, up 13.05 million; IoT connections totaled 1.497 billion. Falling service revenue and profit show traditional connectivity growth has peaked, while flat recurring profit and much stronger cash flow suggest cost control and a slower investment pace are still underpinning earnings quality.

items.title: 中国铁塔前三季度净利润108.17亿元、增24.2%，“两翼”收入占比升至16.3%
items.title_en: China Tower's Nine-Month Net Profit Rises 24.2% to RMB 10.82 Billion; Smart and Energy Businesses Reach 16.3% of Revenue
items.summary: 营收719.99亿元、降3.1%，塔类业务降7.9%、室分增9.6%；智联业务增10.9%、能源业务增13.0%，EBITDA率62.3%。
items.summary_en: Revenue fell 3.1% to RMB 72.0 billion: towers down 7.9%, indoor DAS up 9.6%, smart-connectivity up 10.9% and energy up 13.0%, with a 62.3% EBITDA margin.
items.detail: 10月20日，中国铁塔公布2026年前三季度经营情况。营业收入719.99亿元，同比下降3.1%。其中运营商业务收入596.41亿元、下降6.0%：塔类业务520.52亿元、下降7.9%，室分业务75.89亿元、增长9.6%。“两翼”业务保持增长，智联业务收入78.69亿元、增长10.9%，能源业务收入38.68亿元、增长13.0%，两翼收入占营业收入的比重由去年同期的14.2%提升至16.3%。EBITDA为448.28亿元，占营业收入的62.3%；归母净利润108.17亿元，同比增长24.2%。截至9月底，塔类站址达218.4万个，塔类租户387.2万户，站均租户数1.77户。塔类收入持续下滑，反映运营商在共享与降本上的持续压力；室分业务随5G深度覆盖需求增长，智联与能源业务的稳定双位数增长则让铁塔的收入结构加速多元化。营收下降而利润两位数增长，也显示其成本端仍有较大改善空间。
items.detail_en: On Oct 20, China Tower reported its results for the first three quarters of 2026. Operating revenue was RMB 71.999 billion, down 3.1% year on year. Revenue from operators fell 6.0% to RMB 59.641 billion, with tower business down 7.9% to RMB 52.052 billion and indoor distributed antenna systems up 9.6% to RMB 7.589 billion. The two growth wings kept expanding: smart-connectivity revenue rose 10.9% to RMB 7.869 billion and energy revenue rose 13.0% to RMB 3.868 billion, lifting their share of revenue from 14.2% a year earlier to 16.3%. EBITDA was RMB 44.828 billion, 62.3% of revenue, and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 24.2% to RMB 10.817 billion. At end-September the company had 2.184 million tower sites and 3.872 million tower tenants, or 1.77 tenants per site. Declining tower revenue reflects operators' continued push for sharing and cost cuts; indoor coverage is growing with demand for deep 5G coverage, and steady double-digit growth in smart-connectivity and energy is diversifying revenue. Double-digit profit growth on falling revenue also shows there is still meaningful room on the cost side.

items.title: 中国电信插入式微型智能机顶盒集采结果出炉：600万台、规模约7亿元
items.title_en: China Telecom Names Winners in Plug-In Mini Smart Set-Top Box Tender: 6 Million Units, About RMB 700 Million
items.summary: 青岛海信、四川天邑、北京朝歌、深圳创维、四川长虹为成交候选人，广东九联为备选；设备可直插电视HDMI口，支持4K。
items.summary_en: Hisense (Qingdao), Tianyi (Sichuan), Sunniwell (Beijing), Skyworth (Shenzhen) and Changhong (Sichuan) are winning candidates, with Jiulian (Guangdong) as reserve; the devices plug straight into a TV's HDMI port and support 4K.
items.detail: 10月20日，据中国电信阳光采购网消息，中国电信插入式微型智能机顶盒产品（2026—2028年）集中采购项目已完成评审：青岛海信、四川天邑、北京朝歌、深圳创维、四川长虹为成交候选人，广东九联为备选。按此前招标公告，本项目共集采600万台插入式微型智能机顶盒，规模约7亿元。这类机顶盒采用低功耗器件与紧凑化设计，体积较普通机顶盒缩小80%以上，可直接插在电视机HDMI接口上使用，实现小型化、隐藏化并减少连线；支持4K超高清业务，并搭配基于红外、蓝牙和星闪的三模通用遥控器，用一个遥控器同时控制电视机和机顶盒，实现一键开关机、一键进直播。2025年，广电总局组织中国广电、中国电信、中国联通、中国移动与产业各方部署了超千万台插入式微型机顶盒。此次三年期集采延续了简化电视操作体验的方向，对机顶盒厂商而言是IPTV终端换新的一笔重要订单，星闪也借此进一步进入家庭终端。
items.detail_en: On Oct 20, China Telecom's procurement portal showed that evaluation of its 2026–2028 centralized purchase of plug-in mini smart set-top boxes is complete: Qingdao Hisense, Sichuan Tianyi, Beijing Sunniwell, Shenzhen Skyworth and Sichuan Changhong are the winning candidates, with Guangdong Jiulian as reserve. According to the earlier tender notice, the project covers 6 million units, worth about RMB 700 million. The boxes use low-power components and a compact design more than 80% smaller than a regular set-top box, plugging directly into a TV's HDMI port to cut clutter and cabling; they support 4K UHD and come with a tri-mode infrared/Bluetooth/NearLink universal remote that controls both TV and box, enabling one-press power and one-press live TV. In 2025 the NRTA coordinated China Broadnet, China Telecom, China Unicom, China Mobile and the industry to deploy more than 10 million such boxes. This three-year tender continues the push to simplify TV viewing, gives set-top box makers a sizable IPTV replacement order, and carries NearLink further into home devices.

items.title: 国新办发布会：智能算力达2592 EFLOPS、同比增146%，两家民企获批卫星物联网商用试验
items.title_en: SCIO Briefing: China's Intelligent Computing Power Hits 2,592 EFLOPS, Up 146%, as Two Private Firms Win Approval for Satellite IoT Commercial Trials
items.summary: 工信部信管局局长谢存介绍：5G基站525.4万个、10G PON端口3340万个，前三季度电信业务总量增7.3%；将实施新一代通信网络重大工程与算力扩容。
items.summary_en: MIIT's Xie Cun reported 5.254 million 5G base stations, 33.4 million 10G PON ports and 7.3% growth in telecom business volume in Q1–Q3, with a major new-generation network project and computing expansion next.
items.detail: 10月20日，国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，工信部信息通信管理局局长谢存介绍信息通信业发展情况。业务方面，前三季度电信业务总量同比增长7.3%，1—8月互联网业务收入增长8.9%，三家基础电信企业营收均进入全球前十。网络方面，5G基站达525.4万个，10G PON端口达3340万个，并开展万兆光网试点；智能算力规模达2592 EFLOPS，同比增长146%。融合应用方面，5G已融入国民经济97个大类，工业互联网覆盖全部41个工业大类。市场开放方面，持证电信企业达20.4万家，外资电信企业3455家、增长25%；北京国电高科、浙江时空道宇两家民营企业已获批开展卫星物联网商用试验，下一步将支持更多符合条件的企业参与。面向未来，工信部正推进6G技术试验并组建ION-2030推进组，下一步将实施新一代通信网络重大工程、宽带提质行动和算力扩容。算力增速远超网络与业务增速，意味着通信业投资重心正加速向算力与智算互联迁移。
items.detail_en: At a State Council Information Office briefing on Oct 20, Xie Cun, director of MIIT's Information and Communications Administration, outlined the sector's progress. Telecom business volume grew 7.3% in the first three quarters and internet business revenue rose 8.9% in January–August, with all three basic telecom operators ranking among the world's top ten by revenue. China now has 5.254 million 5G base stations and 33.4 million 10G PON ports, with 10-gigabit optical network pilots under way, and intelligent computing power has reached 2,592 EFLOPS, up 146% year on year. 5G is used in all 97 major economic categories and the industrial internet covers all 41 industrial categories. Licensed telecom companies number 204,000, and foreign-invested telecom firms 3,455, up 25%; two private companies, Beijing Guodian Gaoke and Zhejiang Geespace, have been approved for satellite IoT commercial trials, and more qualified firms will be supported. MIIT is advancing 6G technology trials and has set up an ION-2030 promotion group, and next will launch a major project for new-generation communication networks, a broadband quality-upgrade campaign and computing-power expansion. With computing growing far faster than networks or services, the industry's investment focus is shifting quickly toward computing power and AI-compute interconnection.

industry.section: 卫星互联网与空天地一体化

items.title: SES演示载荷搭乘Planet卫星发射，为NASA商业空间中继服务做全球测试
items.title_en: SES Demo Payload Launches on a Planet Satellite for Global Testing of NASA's Commercial Space Relay Services
items.summary: 随SpaceX Bandwagon-5拼车任务升空；NASA计划逐步退役TDRS中继星座、转向采购商业中继服务，SES将借此完成LEO中继服务演示的收官测试。
items.summary_en: Launched on SpaceX's Bandwagon-5 rideshare; as NASA plans to retire its TDRS relay fleet and buy commercial relay services, SES will use it to complete the capstone test of its LEO Relay Service demonstration.
items.detail: 美东时间10月20日7:04（北京时间19:04），SES全资子公司SES Space & Defense的演示载荷搭乘Planet公司的Pelican-12卫星，随SpaceX Bandwagon-5拼车任务从卡纳维拉尔角发射，服务NASA通信服务项目（CSP）。NASA已宣布将逐步退役TDRS跟踪与数据中继卫星星座，转而采购商业空间中继服务，支持未来近地轨道科学任务；2022年NASA通过CSP向业界拨款2.785亿美元用于相关开发与演示。SES此前已在其地球同步轨道卫星和O3b mPOWER中轨星座上演示LEO中继服务（LRS），提供任务数据回传和航天器健康状态的低、高速率业务。Pelican卫星搭载Planet自研的软件定义无线电与折叠光学平板跟踪天线，用于低时延、高吞吐的任务数据回传，将完成SES CSP演示的全球收官测试。SES方面表示，LRS可在卫星处于任意位置时提供低时延、持续的连接，支撑关键数据回传与测控（TT&C）。NASA同日披露，有两项商业卫星通信演示随该任务发射。低轨卫星经中高轨星座中继回传一旦商业化，遥感星座将不再完全依赖地面站过顶下行。
items.detail_en: At 7:04 a.m. ET on Oct 20 (19:04 Beijing time), a demonstration payload from SES Space & Defense, a wholly owned SES subsidiary, launched aboard Planet's Pelican-12 satellite on SpaceX's Bandwagon-5 rideshare from Cape Canaveral, supporting NASA's Communications Services Project (CSP). NASA has said it will gradually sunset its Tracking and Data Relay Satellite (TDRS) fleet and buy commercial space relay services for future low-Earth-orbit science missions; in 2022 it awarded $278.5 million to industry through CSP for development and demonstration. SES has already demonstrated its LEO Relay Service (LRS) on its geostationary and O3b mPOWER medium-Earth-orbit systems, offering low and high data-rate services for mission backhaul and spacecraft state of health. Pelican carries Planet's in-house software-defined radio and a folded-optic flat-slab tracking antenna for low-latency, high-throughput backhaul, enabling a global capstone test that completes SES's CSP demonstration. SES says LRS provides low-latency, persistent connectivity wherever a satellite is, supporting critical data backhaul and telemetry, tracking and command (TT&C). NASA said two commercial satcom demonstrations flew on the mission. If relaying LEO data through MEO/GEO constellations goes commercial, Earth-observation fleets will no longer depend solely on ground-station passes to downlink.
